scope: Malaysia medical discovery — Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia Faculty of Medicine

institution.canonicalName: Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: The Malaysian Qualifications Register records UKM's Doctor of Medicine as a full-time conventional MQF Level 6 qualification, 238 credits and five years, with Malaysian Medical Council as professional body.
The same MQR record lists accreditation from 1 July 2023 to 30 June 2028.
UKMShape officially states that the Bachelor of Medicine (MDUKM) tuition fee for local and international students is being restructured and that the revised structure is expected by 31 July 2026.

holdReasons: UKM's official notice confirms that the local and international MDUKM tuition structure is under revision; no current amount can be published before the promised 31 July 2026 update.

No complete current first-party international undergraduate admissions page was established for the MDUKM cohort, including application route, qualification/test requirements, documents and intake timing.
No current programme-specific source bundle for clinical structure, accommodation and international-student support was completed.
nextAction: After 31 July 2026, obtain UKM's revised international MDUKM fee schedule and a current Faculty/UKM international admissions notice, then continue the programme evidence packet.
